comment: No source is published. The panel prints Min and Max; the two parameters are configured as Offset and Range, so the maker's own tooltips name them differently from the panel. Random values are drawn with rack::random::local and scaled into Min to Max. When Max is below Min the module writes the Min voltage to both outputs and returns before anything else runs. One light is configured and follows the smooth output, but it has no position in the census and cannot be clicked.
